findings.conclusion: User confirms chart access; no account session, data feed, API entitlement or export right was inspected.

Published TradingView terms restrict machine-driven/non-display use and automated extraction. Chart access, paper-only use, CSV availability or a webhook is not permission for this evaluator. Obtain written source-specific permission before ingestion.

Current terms mention an official MCP interface and a narrow personal question-answering exception; this is not permission to build archives or run this algorithmic evaluator. Account/plan/tool availability was not checked and nothing was connected.

Official help describes manual CSV export of loaded chart data. Public pricing includes feature text but does not reliably resolve this account entitlement; no upgrade, UI login or extraction was attempted. Bar timestamps do not establish historical first-availability receipts.
Official help describes approximately 10,000 intraday bars for Essential/Plus plus interval-boundary extras; actual symbol history and permitted export must be verified separately.

Native default uses intrabar-direction estimates. Optional tick mode can use exchange aggressor flags with fallback methods. The user indicator and mode are unverified. GC trade-side admission requires actual exchange flags and gap evidence; L2 depth is not itself proof of aggressor coverage.
Existing COMEX display subscription does not establish ICE DXY rights, raw trades, history export, API access or non-display licensing. Actual vendor agreements and package detail remain unknown.
